notes.title: Knight Adventure has a big sale this week!
notes.notes:

The time has come! Knight Adventure has a big sale this week! If your gaming device is not a cucumber, you can now take a sword and go to save your Princess on the most awesome Arcade Platformer! Knight Adventure can seem a hardly but it isn't so. You should be patient, confident and faster. If you love it, please tell your friends, favorite streamers, and the gaming media! Have a nice game! :)

notes.title: Коллекционные карточки стали доступны!
notes.notes:

Встречайте коллекционные карточки Knight Adventure с рыцарями, колдуном и принцессой:
- 5 коллекционных карт,
- 5 фонов для страниц,
